entries.proposition: The WWOX-null condition in this paper is an shRNA knockdown or lentiviral overexpression of WWOX in human HCC cell lines, in cells co-cultured with THP-1 macrophages and in humanized NOG mice carrying those cells; no germline Wwox allele, no neural cell and no developmental setting is used.
entries.snippet: To further clarify whether WWOX was required to mediate PD-1 resistance in HCC, we constructed a WWOXlow humanized orthotopic HCC mouse model and compared PD-1 treatment responses.

entries.proposition: The human clinical series is small: serum from 57 PD-1-treated HCC patients (28 responders, 29 non-responders); tumour RNA-seq from 4 responders and 4 non-responders.
entries.snippet: Among them, tumor tissues from 4 PD-1 responder and 4 PD-1 non-responder were used for RNA sequencing.

entries.proposition: WWOX is called the most upregulated fragile-site gene in responders from an 8-sample RNA-seq comparison (4 versus 4).
entries.snippet: Differential analysis revealed WWOX was the most upregulated CFS related gene in ICI response HCC patients (figure 1A).

entries.proposition: Serum WWOX measured by ELISA is reported higher in responders.
entries.snippet: WWOX was detected in the serum of patients receiving PD-1 antibody treatment using ELISA and was more abundant in the responder group (figure 1B, online supplemental table 2).

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 1B and 1E. 1B: serum WWOX in ng/mL, non-responders about 1060 and responders about 1250 (means), individual points overlapping widely, one asterisk. 1E: Kaplan-Meier survival split WWOX low (n=28) versus high (n=29), P = 0.02, and recurrence P = 0.007; the two group sizes equal the responder and non-responder counts.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1B dot plot y-axis 'Serum WWOX level (ng/mL)' 0-2000 with Non-responder and Responder columns and one asterisk; Fig 1E two Kaplan-Meier panels with legends 'WWOXlow (n=28)', 'WWOXhigh (n=29)', P=0.02 and P=0.007.

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 1G. In IgG-treated humanized mice the shWWOX tumours weigh about 0.65 g against about 0.25 g for control tumours (about 2.6-fold larger) with n = 5 per group; under anti-PD-1 the control tumours fall to about 0.03 g and the shWWOX tumours stay near 0.6 g. The PD-1 resistance of shWWOX tumours is therefore measured against a baseline in which the knockdown tumours already grow much larger without PD-1.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1G upper panel tumour weight (g): Control IgG about 0.25, shWWOX IgG about 0.65, Control PD-1 about 0.03, shWWOX PD-1 about 0.60 with ns between shWWOX IgG and shWWOX PD-1; lower panel tumour volume agrees.

entries.proposition: The macrophage-clearance experiment reports only anti-PD-1-treated groups.
entries.snippet: Remarkably, PD-1 treatment significantly reduced tumor growth in the huh7-shWWOX group of mice after macrophage clearance compared with the control group (figure 3F,G).

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 3F. Four groups, all labelled Anti-PD-1: Control, shWWOX, Control+Clophosome, shWWOX+Clophosome; with clophosome the shWWOX tumours drop to about 0.3 g (similar to control about 0.22 g). No IgG-treated clophosome arm is shown, so an effect of macrophage depletion on tumour growth independent of PD-1 is not separated.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3F tumour weight panel with four bars under 'Anti-PD-1': Control about 0.22, shWWOX about 0.72, Control+Clophosome about 0.22, shWWOX+Clophosome about 0.30; x-axis rows list Control, shWWOX, Clophosome pluses; no IgG column.

entries.proposition: OA is named as the most upregulated metabolite in the supernatants of WWOX-knockdown Huh7 cells in an untargeted metabolomics comparison.
entries.snippet: The results of difference analysis suggested that OA was most significantly upregulated in the supernatants of HCC cells in the shWWOX group compared with the control group (figure 4B).

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 4B-C. 4B: oleic acid log2 intensity about 26.9 (control) versus about 27.2 (shWWOX), n = 5 versus 5, one asterisk, about a 1.2-fold difference. 4C: ELISA oleic acid in supernatant, Huh7 about 7.5 (control) versus about 9.8 ng/mL (shWWOX); HCCLM3 about 10.8 (vector) versus about 6.8 ng/mL (WWOX overexpression). The reported shifts are of the order of 1.3-fold up and 0.63-fold down, in conditioned medium.

entries.snippet: Stimulation of PMA-treated THP-1 cells with OA significantly increased macrophage CD206 protein expression and M2-like macrophage marker mRNA levels (figure 4D).

entries.proposition: The supplementary ELISA method describes the WWOX serum kit only; no oleic acid ELISA kit, extraction or calibration is described.
entries.snippet: We measured WWOX levels in serum from HCC patients using the Human WWOX ELISA Kit (Biorbyt, orb1146837).

entries.proposition: WWOX knockdown raises SCD5 mRNA and protein without changing SCD1.
entries.snippet: Western blot assays and qPCR confirmed that WWOX deficiency upregulated SCD5 protein and mRNA levels without affecting SCD1 (figure 4E, online supplemental figure 3C–E).

entries.proposition: The WWOX region needed for binding NME2 is residues 106-414, which contains the SDR domain; the WW-domain region 1-105 is not sufficient.
entries.snippet: We mapped the structural domains involved in the interaction between WWOX and NME2 and found that the WWOX (106-414) and NME2 (67-152) domains were necessary for their interaction (figure 5C).

entries.proposition: The SCD5 inhibitor experiment is described as Huh7 cell-derived humanized orthotopic models, with no WWOX-knockdown arm stated.
entries.snippet: For further drug sensitivity experiments, Huh7 cell-derived humanized orthotopic HCC mouse models were first constructed.

entries.proposition: The SCD inhibitor used, SCD1/5-IN-1, is named as a dual SCD1/SCD5 compound, given at 5 mg/kg daily for 10 days.
entries.snippet: For SCD5 blockage, mice were injected intraperitoneally with 5 mg/kg SCD5 inhibitor SCD1/5-IN-1 (Cat.HY-155403; MedChemExpress) or vehicle control daily for 10 days.

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 6C. Four arms: Vehicle+IgG about 0.33 g, SCD1/5-IN-1 about 0.19 g, anti-PD-1 about 0.14 g, combined about 0.02 g (n = 5, 5, 5, 3); the inhibitor lowers tumour weight alone in tumours that are not WWOX-knockdown by the stated methods, and no shWWOX arm is shown, so WWOX dependence of the drug effect is untested. The combined group shows 3 points where the others show 5.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 6C upper panel tumour weight (g) with four groups Vehicle+IgG, SCD1/5-IN-1, Anti-PD-1, Combined; Combined shows three purple points, the others five.

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Supplementary Figure 6D-G. IHC scores of CD68, CD206 and SCD5 in the inhibitor groups fall from about 2 to about 0.2 in both SCD1/5-IN-1 and Combined, while anti-PD-1 alone leaves all three at about 2.3; NME2 is unchanged. A small-molecule enzyme inhibitor is reported to lower SCD5 protein staining about ten-fold, and anti-PD-1 alone shrinks tumours (Figure 6C) without changing macrophage staining.
